Subject: Thursday Shoot Details + What to Expect 💫

Hi ladies,

I’m so excited to be coming in on Thursday, truly honored to have the opportunity to film inside your space. Everything I’ve seen so far looks beautiful and I know this is going to turn out amazing.

I wanted to send over a quick overview so you know exactly what to expect and how to prepare.

We’ll be arriving around **1:15–1:30 PM** and plan to be there for about **45 minutes to 1 hour** depending on flow and timing. fileciteturn0file0

**What we’ll be doing:**
This will be a very natural, unscripted shoot. Think of it more as capturing real moments versus anything staged. We’ll be filming:
- Me walking through the space
- Interacting with you and your team
- Light conversations, tours, and behind-the-scenes moments
- General B-roll that highlights the vibe and experience of your spa

No pressure at all, I’ll guide everything in the moment so it feels easy and organic.

**What you’ll need to do beforehand:**
- Have the space clean, tidy, and photo-ready
- Make sure anyone who may be on camera is camera-ready (hair/makeup done, etc.)
- Staff can just be present and natural, no need to “perform”
- No clients need to be filmed unless previously approved with consent forms

**A few notes:**
- We’ll be mic’d and capturing real interactions, nothing scripted
- I’ll be the main one on camera, with you all naturally included throughout
- This content is meant to highlight both your space and my consulting work in a really elevated, authentic way

If you have any questions at all before Thursday, feel free to text or email me anytime.

Really looking forward to meeting you in person and creating something beautiful together 🤍

Bethany
